correctness.rationale: All eight scattered-three counts are handled: the three two-one entries plus fixed total zeros force the integral gap displacement \(t(1,-3,3,-1)\); the 001 count forces t=0 or t=(g1-g2)/3; the remaining one-zero entries depend only on the conserved first two moments of prefix-zero counts. Legal nonzero solutions form a unique involutive partner. Each pair is uniquely oriented by positive t and counted by four nonnegative gap parameters with total zeros u+v+2h+4t. Geometric series yields the stated rational GF; class count equals binomial(n,3) minus doubletons. The packaged verifier independently exhausts every class for 3<=n<=19 (4,845 words, 370 doubletons), confirms direct-vs-dynamic deck counts for n<=16, 62 seeded larger partner comparisons, and the exact sum/quasipolynomial through n=400. Finite checks supplement the infinite symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: This is a proof of the already published but explicitly unproved Conjecture 1 of Chrisnata et al. The source supplies a null direction and finite evidence but neither the necessary-and-sufficient partner involution nor an all-n enumeration. The 2026 general-deck and restricted-reconstruction results do not imply that missing exact count. Searches of accessible literature and indexed claims found no proven equivalence. Unindexed solutions and independent priority are residual uncertainties.
residual_risks: A previously published or independent all-n proof could be absent from the accessible primary/indexed sources.

The 2021/2023 source already contains a linear null-vector identity and a proposed formula; the precise novelty claimed is the missing proof and complete fiber classification, not the expression or the first collision.

value.rationale: Section 5.3, Conjecture 1 in Chrisnata et al. explicitly asks for the exact all-length rational generating function; previous work provides finite checking and only \(\\(\Theta(n^3)\)\). The result proves that natural conjecture, exhibits every ambiguity partner, determines complete fiber sizes and the exact fixed-content zero-error codebook capacity, including a period-four quasipolynomial and limiting proportion 7/8. This is a structurally motivated complete classification, not a routine recomputation of a known table.
